title: dubrueilia microphylla
intro: Dubrueilia microphylla, commonly known as Hedeoma, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to relieve digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Dubrueilia microphylla include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues and calm the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
